scope: MP-A2 and MP-G2 method/purpose adjudication; original preserved HTML sections, downloaded example sources, four actual PNG payloads and three official diffs. Reviewed FINAL_AUDIT and final lineage/returns for consistent wording.
review_type: Separate AI read, not human review, not blind; results and preregistered targets were visible. Cross-agent coordination followed original-source read. No example execution or browser navigation.
mutations: Only this new review JSON under evidence/ggplot2; no Matplotlib or sealed file edit.
source_count_reason: All materials reread here were already admitted to component ledgers; this review creates no new independent work or case.

findings.reason: The sealed specific target couples Axes.text rotation, ha/va/bbox and default mode. The new default branch still uses Axes.text(rotation=40,horizontalalignment=ha,verticalalignment=va,rotation_mode=mode), and prose preserves rotation then alignment. Its bbox depiction changes from passing bbox to Axes.text to draw/get_window_extent/Rectangle. The anchor branch still passes bbox; this is not deletion of the bbox API or loss of text rotation/alignment.
findings.images_observed: Old image has five angles in center/center and left/bottom rows. New image compares default and anchor with left/center/right and top/center/baseline/bottom; default highlighting is axis-aligned rectangle. Original PNG bytes viewed, not reconstructed.
findings.official_change_support: Author states old example duplicates the more complete Text Rotation Mode example, removes old source and adds redirect-from.
findings.wording_required: Axes.text 회전·정렬 YES / default bbox 강조 방법 NO / 원 다섯 각도 recipe NO. Do not abbreviate this to API-method loss.
findings.change_condition: If the task defines method only as rotation/alignment, method outcome is YES. Preserve the sealed conjunctive method target and show the narrower core result separately. A confirmed new default branch using the old bbox recipe would change specific NO.

findings.reason: Frozen original purpose names Men/Women scores for G1-G5. New source and PNG replace this with three penguin attributes for Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo. Grouped bars, numeric labels and Axes.bar horizontal offsets plus bar_label survive. Two explicit symmetric x±width/2 bar calls and two label calls are replaced by a three-iteration loop. Original purpose and general role must remain separate.
findings.images_observed: Old PNG visibly shows Men/Women legend, Scores and five G groups. New PNG visibly shows Bill Depth/Bill Length/Flipper Length and three penguin species with Length(mm).
findings.official_change_support: First change replaces Men/Women with Tea/Coffee; later change explicitly refactors to loops and penguin data.
findings.wording_required: Same actively referenced path with changed content/purpose. It must not fill the retained-path-but-unused direction.
findings.negative_scope: Component author searched all 522 fixed new gallery Python sources and read 10 candidate bodies. Independent reviewer read search ledger and all 10 candidate metadata/prose records, source excerpts for misc/demo_agg_filter and earlier records; did not repeat the full 522-source scan or independently read all 10 full source/HTML candidates.
findings.independent_countercase: misc/demo_agg_filter.py lines245-267 reuses near-barchart data but hides both axes and adds DropShadowFilter/FilteredArtistList. No Men/Women/G1-G5 score labels or numeric bar_label in this excerpt, supporting the distinction between similar graphical code and the original purpose.
findings.change_condition: An authored, linked successor within fixed 3.7.0 preserving the original Men/Women G1-G5 score purpose would reverse original-U NO. Choosing only general grouped-bar pedagogy yields U YES and makes direct new-section return sufficient.

source_count_advice.no_repair_of_missing_direction: Neither official helper records nor same-path byte replacement is an observed unused residual-image case.

limitations: G remains 미확인 for every reviewed edition: static source and published image do not identify a historical run manifest/output fingerprint.
Raw HTML endpoints serve text/plain; DOM ids are static location records. No rendered browser arrival or fragment scrolling was independently tested.
Original-purpose NO for MP-G2 is bounded by the documented fixed gallery search, not the entire web or all tutorials.
The added purpose axes were committed after path/selection exposure but before new-body reads; do not report them as wholly pre-signal preregistration.
This review makes no claims about uninspected main slots or the full negative candidate universe.
overall: Accept current MP final adjudication with its explicit dimensions and limits. Do not collapse method_specific into method_core_api, or original-purpose U into visual-role U.
